notes: Historical revenue, operating income (EBIT), and D&A (from cash flow depreciation/amortization total) come from Southern Company’s consolidated FY2025 Form 10-K statements. ([s27.q4cdn.com](https://s27.q4cdn.com/273397814/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/978d3eb6-1b36-4ea1-8686-480789bca55a.pdf))

Capex is modeled as absolute cash “Property additions” from the FY2025 Form 10-K cash flow statement (not including nuclear decommissioning trust fund activity). ([s27.q4cdn.com](https://s27.q4cdn.com/273397814/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/978d3eb6-1b36-4ea1-8686-480789bca55a.pdf))

NWC is defined (and forecasted) as (Total current assets − Cash and cash equivalents) − Total current liabilities; cash is excluded from NWC because cash is modeled separately in the DCF inputs. ([s27.q4cdn.com](https://s27.q4cdn.com/273397814/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/978d3eb6-1b36-4ea1-8686-480789bca55a.pdf))

NOL inputs: nol_balance is interpreted as the approximate net state income tax benefit of NOL carryforwards (not total gross NOL dollars), and nol_utilization_pct is derived from the valuation allowance implied in the same disclosure. ([s27.q4cdn.com](https://s27.q4cdn.com/273397814/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/978d3eb6-1b36-4ea1-8686-480789bca55a.pdf))

WACC is taken as a published estimate (0.0532) from StockAnalysis.com; actual institution-specific WACC may differ due to different betas, spreads, and capital-structure targets. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/so/statistics/))

Comparable multiples: EV/NTM revenue and EV/NTM EBITDA fields are populated using StockAnalysis EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA ratios as a proxy because strictly labeled NTM multiples were not captured in the sourced inputs. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nee/statistics/))

Preferred equity not separately disclosed as a consolidated line item in the extracted balance-sheet presentation; set to null to avoid misclassification. ([s27.q4cdn.com](https://s27.q4cdn.com/273397814/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/978d3eb6-1b36-4ea1-8686-480789bca55a.pdf))
Current_price is sourced as a market quote near the research date; tool timestamp reflects Mar 20, 2026 close while as_of_date is set to 2026-03-21 per the instructions.

catalysts: Utility rate cases and regulatory approvals that affect the timing and level of recoverable costs and allowed returns.
Construction milestones and plant in-service outcomes (e.g., nuclear/fleet reliability and long-lived asset commissioning) that drive depreciation, revenue, and operating leverage.
Financing environment (interest-rate trajectory and credit spreads) impacting the effective cost of capital and regulatory capital recovery.
company_overview: Southern Company’s electric utilities generate and sell electricity to retail and wholesale customers under U.S. state/federal utility regulation. ([s27.q4cdn.com](https://s27.q4cdn.com/273397814/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/978d3eb6-1b36-4ea1-8686-480789bca55a.pdf))

The company also participates in natural gas operations (distribution and related services), with results influenced by regulatory recovery and pass-through mechanisms. ([s27.q4cdn.com](https://s27.q4cdn.com/273397814/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/978d3eb6-1b36-4ea1-8686-480789bca55a.pdf))

FY2025 consolidated total operating revenues were $29,553,000,000 with operating income of $7,285,000,000. ([s27.q4cdn.com](https://s27.q4cdn.com/273397814/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/978d3eb6-1b36-4ea1-8686-480789bca55a.pdf))
current_context: FY2025 results (filed in the FY2025 Form 10-K dated Feb 18–19, 2026) show operating revenues of $29,553,000,000 and operating income of $7,285,000,000. ([s27.q4cdn.com](https://s27.q4cdn.com/273397814/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/978d3eb6-1b36-4ea1-8686-480789bca55a.pdf))

Capital intensity remains elevated: cash “Property additions” were $12,737,000,000 in 2025, and the 10-K provides estimated total capital expenditures for 2026–2030 (Southern Company total). ([s27.q4cdn.com](https://s27.q4cdn.com/273397814/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/978d3eb6-1b36-4ea1-8686-480789bca55a.pdf))
Model uses WACC estimate of 0.0532 (5.32%) from StockAnalysis.com as the discount rate input. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/so/statistics/))
investment_highlights: Revenue growth is modeled as modest and progressively normalizing, consistent with a regulated, rate-based earnings profile (base-case revenue growth declines from 4.5% in 2026 to ~3.1% by 2030).

EBIT margin is held near recent levels (base-case target long-run EBIT margin of 0.245) to reflect regulatory recovery while allowing mild normalization from elevated FY2024 profitability. ([s27.q4cdn.com](https://s27.q4cdn.com/273397814/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/978d3eb6-1b36-4ea1-8686-480789bca55a.pdf))

Large depreciation base is reflected with D&A at ~0.198–0.200 of sales, consistent with historical D&A intensity. ([s27.q4cdn.com](https://s27.q4cdn.com/273397814/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/978d3eb6-1b36-4ea1-8686-480789bca55a.pdf))
Cash return capacity is supported by persistently negative working-capital profile (modeled NWC as % of sales around -0.235 to -0.225).
key_risks: Regulatory disallowances, deferrals, or timing mismatches that reduce earnings and cash-flow conversion versus modeled assumptions.

Higher-than-modeled capital needs or construction cost overruns that pressure free cash flow (capex intensity risk). ([s27.q4cdn.com](https://s27.q4cdn.com/273397814/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/978d3eb6-1b36-4ea1-8686-480789bca55a.pdf))
Working-capital volatility (e.g., under/over-recovery balances and operating cash timing) given persistently negative modeled NWC.

valuation_summary: Base-case DCF uses Gordon growth terminal method with terminal growth of 0.02 and WACC of 0.0532; sensitivity is embedded via bull/bear WACC and terminal-growth overrides.

Comparable-company context is included using EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA plus forward P/E from StockAnalysis.com statistics pages (not strictly NTM by definition). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/so/statistics/))
